title: rest.search.response
description: GET /api/search response: the best matches of the query in the vault, best first.

query.description: The query as it was asked.

kind.description: notes: notes/apuntes.md; page: a page transcription; pdf: the text of a PDF page; web: a web page; transcript: one final transcript segment.

path.description: The vault-relative file the text is in.

source.description: The vault-relative source the file belongs to (GET /api/sources/{source}); absent for notes and transcripts.

session.description: The session of a transcript hit.

t_start.description: When the transcript segment starts, in ms since the session started.

snippet.description: The matching passage, each matched term between U+0002 and U+0003.
